Markets.title: Dollar near 19-month high on Fed hike bets, yen tests 160
Markets.summary: The U.S. dollar reached a 19-month high and the yen tested 160 as traders anticipated a larger-than-usual Federal Reserve interest rate hike. This followed remarks from U.S. President Donald Trump regarding Iran, which contributed to the sharpest two-day rise in two-year Treasury yields in 3.5 years.

Markets.summary: Gold prices increased slightly on Friday, recovering from a more than one-year low reached in the previous session. Despite this daily gain, the metal remained on track for a weekly decline driven by concerns over Federal Reserve rate hikes and rising oil prices.

Markets.title: Jensen Huang forfeits $108 million in unvested Nvidia equity
Markets.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has forfeited $108 million in unvested company equity. According to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, this relinquished amount represents approximately 0.08% of his $138.4 billion net worth.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks gain after Nvidia shakeup, oil steady
Markets.summary: Asian stocks and U.S. equity futures rose following a 4.3% drop in Nvidia shares. The decline in Nvidia occurred after CEO Jensen Huang was ousted.

Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the United States including European leaders in peace talks with Russia. He stated their involvement is logical given Ukraine's goal of eventually joining the European Union.

Geo-Political.summary: The Ethiopian army has seized control of most of Tigray's major towns. It remains uncertain whether the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) retains the capability to retaliate.

Geo-Political.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian drone struck a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland. This incident marks the first recorded Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian vessel in the open Baltic Sea.

Geo-Political.summary: Schools across Italy faced bomb threats for a second consecutive day, triggering widespread panic and evacuations. Authorities are currently investigating the incidents to ensure the safety of students and staff.

Geo-Political.summary: Police stated that four Sydney Swans Australian rules footballers will not face charges following an investigation into an alleged sexual assault in a Melbourne hotel. The players had been under scrutiny after an incident following a game in Melbourne.

Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to reassure investors about policy continuity and incentives. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing reforms to accelerate business and economic growth in the state.

Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 growth forecast to 7%. The ratings agency expects the country to sustain this growth rate through 2028, driven by domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's increased India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience against energy shocks. However, the agency warned that inflation, a deficient monsoon, and El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

Data & Insights.summary: PK Mishra stated that climate change goes beyond environmental issues to threaten agriculture, water supplies, food prices, public health, and livelihoods. He emphasized that scientific research and detailed data are essential for solving these climate and food security challenges.

Data & Insights.title: How the government finance math looks more challenging in H2 FY27
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre's fiscal position weakened in the first half of fiscal year 27 compared to previous years, though it stayed within manageable limits. The second half is expected to be more challenging due to a fading dividend cushion and the need for stronger spending and income tax collections to meet Budget targets.

India.title: Tripura Minor Girl Rescued From Suspected Human Trafficking Network
India.summary: A minor girl from Tripura who went missing on October 13 has been rescued from a suspected human trafficking network. She had been persuaded by a woman named Nishima Ben to travel to Bengaluru for a film audition.

India.title: Verka Increases Milk Prices By Rs 1 To Rs 8 From Today
India.summary: Verka has increased milk prices by Rs 1 to Rs 8, effective today. Following the revision, one-litre packs of full cream milk now cost Rs 76, and standard milk costs Rs 69.

India.title: UP Gave A Chance To BJP, Opposition, Needs New Option: Chandrashekhar Azad
India.summary: Politician Chandrashekhar Azad stated that the public has experienced corruption and injustice during the BJP's nearly 10-year rule in Uttar Pradesh. He concluded that voters need a new political option because they have already tried both the BJP and the opposition.

He emphasized that affordability is essential for achieving success with artificial intelligence in the country.

India.title: 4 Food Stalls Destroyed In Fire At Shillong Literary Fest Venue
India.summary: A fire at the Shillong Literary Fest venue destroyed four food stalls during the event. Organizers were forced to halt an ongoing musical program as a result of the fire.
